up.title: Darsi Super
up.lead: Everything in Darsi stays free. Super adds a live tutor for your courses.
up.f1: Ask anything about your lessons, in Egyptian Arabic or English, and get an answer from the course itself.
up.f2: Short explainer videos, made on the spot for your question.
up.f3: Quick checks that you really understood, and another way to explain it when you didn't.
up.haveOrg: Your organization gives you Darsi Super until {date}.
up.soon: Payments open soon. Thank you for wanting Super!
up.offline: Connect to the internet to see the plans.
up.loadError: The plans didn't load. Try again in a moment.
up.account: Create a free account to get Super
up.orgsBody: Seats for your teachers and students, paid once a year. Your organization admin can ask for a licence.
up.moreBody: Used your allowance? Packs add credits that never expire. The tutor tells you how many credits each answer and explainer used.
up.f4: A clear allowance of tutor credits each month, and packs when you need more.
up.done: Thank you! Your payment is being confirmed; Super starts within a minute.
up.payError: The payment page didn't open. Check your connection and try again.
